category: shipping/damaged

# Damaged-in-Transit Widgets

## Immediate handling

A widget reported damaged in transit gets a free replacement shipped the
same day the customer provides a photo of the damage, no return of the
damaged unit required for orders under $150. For orders at or above $150,
a prepaid return label is included with the replacement and the customer
has 14 days to send the damaged unit back before a charge is applied for
an unreturned high-value item.

## What counts as transit damage vs. defect

Crushed packaging, visible impact marks, or a widget that arrived in
pieces is transit damage - handled here, free replacement, no restocking
fee, no refund-window clock. A widget that arrived in perfect packaging
but doesn't power on or function correctly is a product/defect case
instead, which has a different (longer) diagnostic process before a
replacement ships.

## Multiple damaged items in one order

If more than one item in a multi-widget order is damaged, replace all
damaged units in a single shipment rather than issuing separate
replacement orders - this avoids double-charging shipping and keeps the
case as one ticket instead of splintering into several.
